function.name: local.run
function.description: Execute a saved script by filename in absolute cwd. Save with script_patch in an earlier call. Extensions: .sh uses zsh, .py uses python3, .js/.mjs/.cjs use Bun. Optional args are literal strings. Each execution uses a private snapshot unaffected by later patches. timeoutMs defaults to 30000, max 300000; timeout kills the process group. stdout/stderr each retain their last 65536 characters. Waits for completion; nonzero exit means failure.
